name: Marginalia
description: Read with a pen: highlight a passage, look a word up, copy it with a citation, and ask @margin about it. Its answers land in the passage's margin thread.

color.description: the highlight's theme tone: default, good, warn, bad, dim or accent

answer.description: a command that answers @margin: the prompt on its stdin, the answer on its stdout (for example ["claude", "-p"]). Left out, @margin answers from the note itself, and says so

session.description: how the answer command starts and resumes a thread's session, {id} for its id (claude needs none: --session-id {id}, --resume {id})

actions.label: Highlight
actions.description: Highlight the passage: an annotation with no body, kind highlight, in a tone

actions.label: Define
actions.description: Look the words up in the note (a glossary line: **term**: meaning, or term — meaning) and write the meaning in the margin

actions.label: Cite
actions.description: Copy the passage with a citation: the quote, then where it's from (((id^fragment)) when its line has one)

agents.name: margin
agents.description: Answers a question about a passage, in its margin thread: @margin what does this mean? A thread is one conversation: a later @margin there resumes it; a reply without @margin is never sent
